'''''Haworthiopsis limifolia''''', formerly '''''Haworthia limifolia''''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asphodelaceae]].<ref name=POWO>{{cite taxon |POWO |id=77138013-1 |title=''Haworthiopsis limifolia'' (Marloth) G.D.Rowley |access-date=January 29, 2026}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{Catalogue of Life |id=6LFBH |title=''Haworthiopsis limifolia'' (Marloth) G.D.Rowley |access-date=January 29, 2026}}</ref> It is native to southern Africa and first described in 1910.<ref>[http://haworthiaupdates.org/haworthia-revisited-49-haworthia-limifolia/ Haworthia limifolia - Haworthia Revisited]</ref><ref>Marloth, Hermann Wilhelm Rudolf. 1910. Transactions of the Royal Society of South Africa  i. 409</ref>

==Distribution==
It is native to southeastern Africa (southern Mozambique, Swaziland, [[KwaZulu-Natal]], and [[Mpumalanga]]).<ref name=WCSP_490814/><ref>Germishuizen, G. & Meyer, N.L. (eds.) (2003). Plants of Southern Africa: an annotated checklist. Strelitzia 14.: i-vi, 1-1231. National Botanical Institute, Pretoria.</ref>

==Varieties==
It is a relatively widespread species, with several known varieties, including ''arcana'', ''gigantea'', ''glaucophylla'', ''keithii'', ''striata'', ''ubomboensis''.<ref>[http://haworthiaupdates.org/chapter-4-haworthia-limifolia-var-arcana-smith-crouch/ Haworthia limifolia var arcana]</ref><ref>[http://haworthiaupdates.org/a-new-variety-of-haworthia-limifolia-from-natal-1962/ Haworthia limifolia var gigantea]</ref><ref>[http://haworthiaupdates.org/chapter-3-where-to-h-limifolia-3/ Haworthia limifolia varieties - Haworthia Updates]</ref>
